hypothesis: The gradient trajectory absent from isolated tail and FF2 blocks is created by jointly applying nc_concat_optimization to causal key, value, and output roots; reduced root sets will deterministically remove or isolate the ff2_0 and ff_bias2_0 deviation while preserving forward identity.
interfaces_exposed: Frozen concat root subset {output,key,value} -> complete source graph named gradient trajectory
kill_condition: Stop on any source, archive, trace, naming, or repeat failure; retire joint root scope if output-only and full roots yield the same FF2 and bias gradients or if reduced variants do not isolate a deterministic transition.
promotion_condition: Authorize one exact root-scope parity child only if full roots reproduce all bound named gradient bytes, every variant preserves archive and trace identity and repeats, output-only matches the PyTorch FF2 and bias gradients, and adding a frozen key/value root set reproduces the full bound gradients.
rejection_reason: All variants passed source and repeat identities. Full roots changed some earlier gradients, but output-only, key+output, value+output, and full each reproduced bound ff2_0 and ff_bias2_0 exactly. Root-set membership does not isolate the FF2 divergence; test upstream output-root connectivity with forward-identical stop-grad controls.
retired_neighborhoods: Synthetic FF2-to-loss extensions; ordinary primitive changes; unnamed-gradient inference.
title: NNCP v3.3 LibNC concat root-scope gradient
